morphology.pattern_note: 沿用数据包的未拆分形式；尚未核实为马来语普通词。若指人名，应写作 Kishan，读音须以本人用法为准。

senses.zh_definition: Kishan：人名。现有证据可确认其作为姓名使用，但不足以确认小写 kishan 是具有独立释义的标准马来语普通词。
senses.en_definition: Kishan, a personal name; not verified here as a Malay common word.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas orang yang dieja Kishan; takrif sebagai kata umum bahasa Melayu belum dapat disahkan.
senses.nuances: 本义项为已见证的人名用法说明，并非DBP官方释义。马来西亚国会人员目录出现此姓名；这不能证明数据包中的词项必定指该人名。以下搭配和例句仅示范姓名的句法位置，不代表高频词汇搭配。来源：[马来西亚国会人员目录](https://www.parlimen.gov.my/direktori-staffs.html?Submit=Cari&depart_id=2&uweb=web)。

dual_scenarios.context: 职场汇报；假设Kishan为同事姓名的自拟例句
dual_scenarios.ms: Kishan akan membentangkan laporan projek dalam mesyuarat esok.
dual_scenarios.zh: Kishan将在明天的会议上汇报项目情况。
dual_scenarios.en: Kishan will present the project report at tomorrow's meeting.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp；假设Kishan为朋友姓名的自拟对话
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Kishan dah sampai kat kafe ke?
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Adakah Kishan sudah tiba di kafe?
dual_scenarios.en: Has Kishan arrived at the café yet?
spoken_features: 句末ke在口语中标记一般疑问。

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Kishan dah sampai kat kafe ke?
messages.ms_standard: Adakah Kishan sudah tiba di kafe?
messages.en: Has Kishan arrived at the café yet?

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Dah, dia tunggu kat dalam je. Jom masuk.
messages.ms_standard: Ya, dia sudah tiba dan sedang menunggu di dalam. Mari kita masuk.
messages.zh: 到了，他就在里面等。走，进去吧。
messages.en: Yes, he's waiting inside. Let's go in.

etymology.historical_story: A name can enter a word-frequency list simply because people are mentioned in documents. Kishan appears as a personal name in Malaysia's parliamentary staff directory. That establishes local name usage, but does not establish a Malay common-word meaning or identify the source of this packet. Its linguistic origin remains unverified here. [Source](https://www.parlimen.gov.my/direktori-staffs.html?Submit=Cari&depart_id=2&uweb=web).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先记身份：Kishan是可见于姓名中的拼写；大写首字母帮助识别人名，不强配中文谐音或普通词义。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 称呼具体人士时，尊重本人姓名拼写、发音和称谓偏好；正式交流可在确认适用后使用Encik等称谓。
